# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root: it holds the rules for every
contributor and coding agent (branch and pull request, Conventional Commits,
spec first, tests with the code, read-only tools, `npm run quality` before
pushing).

When investigating a system with this project's MCP server (`.vscode/mcp.json`),
follow its instructions: playbook first, evidence quoted with its source and
time, no conclusion without evidence, and never change the system.
